title: Successful login with valid username and password
preconditions: A valid account exists (username: tomsmith, password: SuperSecretPassword!)
expected_result: User is redirected to /secure, a success flash message "You logged into a secure area!" is displayed, and the Logout button is visible.

title: Authenticated session persists on direct navigation to /secure
preconditions: User has successfully logged in (see TC-LOGIN-SUCCESS-001) and the session cookie is still valid
steps: While logged in, navigate away from /secure (e.g. to /login)
Navigate directly to /secure via the URL bar
expected_result: The /secure page loads directly without redirecting to /login; the user remains authenticated and the secure area content is shown.
